sections.title: Automation that is safe to trust with real operations

blocks.heading: Confidence thresholds and exception routing
paragraphs: Every extraction or decision carries a confidence score. High-confidence items flow straight through; low-confidence items and policy exceptions are routed to a reviewer with the evidence highlighted. Thresholds are tuned with your team against measured error rates.

blocks.heading: Integration is most of the work
paragraphs: The AI model is rarely the hardest part. Reliable automation depends on robust connectors to ERP, CRM, email, document stores and legacy systems — with retries, idempotency and rollback for write operations. We scope integrations explicitly so there are no surprises.

blocks.heading: Measured, auditable results
paragraphs: We baseline the current process — volume, handling time, error rate — before building, then report straight-through-processing rate, accuracy and time saved after launch. Every automated action is logged for audit.

items.question: How is AI automation different from RPA?
items.answer: RPA follows fixed rules and screen steps, so it breaks on unstructured inputs and format changes. AI automation uses models to read documents, understand language and make bounded judgments, which lets it handle variable inputs. The two are often combined: AI interprets the input, and APIs or RPA execute the action.

items.question: How much do AI automation services cost?
items.answer: A focused single-workflow automation typically costs $15,000–$60,000. Multi-step orchestration runs $50,000–$150,000, and enterprise automation platforms $120,000–$400,000. Integration complexity is the biggest variable.

items.question: What happens when the AI is not sure?
items.answer: Low-confidence results and policy exceptions are routed to a human reviewer with the relevant evidence highlighted. Reviewer corrections are logged and can be used to improve the system over time.

items.question: Which systems can you integrate with?
items.answer: Common targets include SAP, Oracle and NetSuite ERPs, Salesforce and HubSpot CRMs, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, ServiceNow and Zendesk, SharePoint and cloud storage, plus legacy systems via ETL or screen automation where no API exists.

items.question: How quickly will we see ROI?
items.answer: We baseline the current process before building so ROI is measurable. High-volume workflows such as AP processing or ticket triage are usually the fastest to pay back; we give a project-specific estimate during discovery.

items.question: Is our data secure?
items.answer: We deploy in your cloud account or on-premise where required, use enterprise model endpoints that do not train on your data, and apply role-based access, encryption and audit logging.
